relations: When the textured roller contacts the vertical bars, it deposits green paint to coat the metal uniformly.
As the roller translates horizontally, the applied green paint spreads across the fence grid.
The existing green coating persists, allowing newly rolled areas to blend seamlessly into the uniform color.
The horizontal rod holding the roller maintains alignment with the vertical bars during the painting process.
caption: A paint roller, dipped in green paint, is used to cover a section of a metal fence, creating a uniform green coat.
